notesDetails.title: Fastest End-to-End Run on Leaderboard (14m 5.2s Across 259 Micro-Turns at 1.82s/Turn, $0.23 Dashboard / $0.22 JSONL), Cleared S1–S6 (6/7) With Zero Credo Setup
bullets: Exact Wall-Clock Alignment (`14m5s` Note vs. `14m 5.2s` JSONL): Following the pre-run `init` commit (`a80e59c` at `15:16:17 WIB`), session `01a1f807-b1a6-75db-915f-321a7b7d5f6f` opened at `2026-11-20T08:16:56.230Z` (`15:16:56.230 WIB`), dispatched Turn 1 at `15:16:58 WIB`, finished Turn 259 at `15:31:01.361 WIB`, and logged `session_exit` (`kind: "normal"`) at `15:31:01.425 WIB` for an exact active duration of `14m 5.20s` (`845.20s` / `14m`)—beating `pi-deepseek-flash-high` (`18m 11s`) as the fastest run on the leaderboard.

Model Selector, Sidecar Exclusion & 8 Organic Commits: `model_change` (Line 3) and all `259` assistant turns confirm `omp v19.0.1` ran `subq/subq-savant-1.4` (`api: "openai-completions"`, `thinkingLevel: "high"`) at `$0.10 / $0.01 / $0.50` per 1M (`4M` context window, early access). One internal `omp v19.0.1` sidecar call (`type: "model_usage"`, `purpose: "sharpshooter:extract"`, `google-vertex/gemini-3.8-flash`, `1,002` in / `106` out, `$0.001149`) at Line 14 is excluded from the `259` agent turns. Starting from `a80e59c` (`init`), the agent made `8` clean commits (`02ca421` S1 through `da5edea` S7 plus `75f0126` fixing unknown-flag wording and recording verification notes in `PLAN.md`).

40/40 Tests Clean & Zero External Deps (No Credo): Manual `mix test` passed `40/40` in `22.5s` (`21.1s async, 1.4s sync`, matching `22.8s` at Line 817 in JSONL), and `mix format --check-formatted` exited `0`. Like `pi-deepseek-flash-high` and `pi-muse-spark-1-3-contrib-high`, the agent kept `deps: []` empty and never installed Credo.

notesDetails.title: Why S7 Failed Holdout (6/7 Matching Manual Note): Deferred S1 Wrapper Decision, Conceded 'Ctrl-C Is the BEAM's' & Shipped Dead-Code Interrupt Module
bullets: Deferring S1's Entry-Point Mandate (`PLAN.md` Lines 36–40) Led Directly to S7 Surrender: In S1, the agent probed foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` (hitting a 30s timeout on background job `bg_2` at Line 39) and confirmed that a bare BEAM escript shows the `BREAK` menu and rejects `:os.set_signal(:sigint, ...)` (Line 47). Instead of resolving the entry point in S1 with a `/bin/sh` wrapper + `+B i` (even after proving at Line 590 that `sh -c 'trap "echo got-int; exit 130" INT'` catches `^C` cleanly), it kept `cb` as a bare escript (`escript: [main_module: CapyBench.CLI, name: "cb"]`, no `emu_args`). In S7, it spent `71` turns (`$0.09`, `39%` of total cost) probing `/dev/tty`, `stty`, `Port`, and `+Bd`/`+Bc`, then conceded in `PLAN.md` (Lines 100–104): `"Unverified: terminal Ctrl-C itself... Ctrl-C is the BEAM's, not this code's."`—checking `[x]` on S7 despite failing the requirement (matching the evaluator's `- [ ] S7` holdout verdict).

All 7 Live Foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` Probes Died Immediately (`rc=-2`, No Summary) & Dead-Code `Interrupt` Handler: Every foreground PTY probe (`50ms`, `150ms`, `500ms` pacing, `1.0s` slow `800ms` server, `0.5s` slow `1.5s` server, `1.0s` stalled `3.5s` server, and `1.5s` live `https://rizafahmi.com`) terminated immediately on raw `SIGINT` (`rc=-2`, printing only `^C` with zero partial summary). Moreover, the fallback `lib/capy_bench/interrupt.ex` (66 LoC) claiming to catch `:sigterm`/`:sigquit`/`:sighup` is broken dead code: lines 28–32 call `:os.set_signal(signal, :handle)` and spawn a plain process waiting on `receive do {:signal, _} -> ... end` without ever registering a `:gen_event` handler on `:erl_signal_server` (after failing `:gen_event.swap_handler/3` at Line 731).

notesDetails.title: Compact 513-LoC Core Cleared Live HTTP/HTTPS (14/14 HTTPS 200), But S3 & S7 Consumed 69% of All Turns (178/259) in Sequential Micro-Steps
bullets: Clean Live S1–S6 Holdout Verification: Across just `513` production LoC in 5 modules (`http.ex` 172, `runner.ex` 134, `cli.ex` 113, `interrupt.ex` 66, `stats.ex` 28) and `700` test LoC, S1–S6 passed every live probe cleanly: `--help`/`-h` exited `0`, all invalid arguments (`[]`, `ftp://`, `not-a-url`, `--unknown`, extra args) exited `2` on stderr with empty stdout, `./cb https://rizafahmi.com` passed (`rc=0`, empty stderr, `14/14` HTTP `200`, `0` transport failures, `p50 295 ms, p95 928 ms`, verifying system CAs via `:public_key.cacerts_get()` and `:public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)`), and `./cb http://rizafahmi.com` passed with `44/44` HTTP `301` (`p50 98 ms, p95 132 ms`).

Micro-Turn Execution Style (`1.07` Tools/Turn): Only `17` of `259` turns (`6.6%`) batched multiple tool calls (max `3`). S3 (`107` turns, `$0.07`, Lines 96–428) and S7 (`71` turns, `$0.09`, Lines 574–794) accounted for `68.7%` of all turns (`178/259`) and `69.6%` of total spend (`$0.16/$0.23`). S3's high turn count stemmed from iterative small-step fixes in `test/support/test_server.ex` and `test/support/test_certs.ex` (missing `:ssl` in `extra_applications` at Line 206 and `openssl req` flag syntax at Lines 347–359)—yet took only `3m 36s` wall-clock thanks to sub-2s turn latency.

notesDetails.title: 99.41% Prefix Cache Hit Rate ($0.23 Dashboard / $0.2226 JSONL, $1.50 Saved), 1.82s/Turn Inference & Exact Audit of 16 isError + 55 Pipeline-Masked Bash Exits
bullets: SubQ Dashboard (`$0.23`) vs. JSONL Telemetry (`$0.222625`) & `$1.50` Cache Savings: Across `259` turns, `subq-savant-1.4` processed `16,790,999` prompt tokens (`99,415` uncached at `$0.10/1M` = `$0.0099` + `16,691,584` cached at `$0.01/1M` = `$0.1669`; `99.41%` cache hit rate with `258/258` post-Turn-1 hits and zero evictions as context grew monotonically from `5,911` to `118,311` prompt tokens—just `2.96%` of its `4.00M` context window) and `91,535` output tokens including `28,963` reasoning tokens (`31.6%` of output) at `$0.50/1M` (`$0.0458`), totaling `16,882,534` tokens. The SubQ billing dashboard recorded `$0.23` (`$0.222625` unrounded in JSONL, saving `$1.50` / `87.1%` vs. the `$1.72` uncached counterfactual). Because `cacheRead` is `$0.01/1M` (90% off vs. DeepSeek's 98% off), cached prompt reads drove `75.0%` of total cost.

Blistering `1.82s/Turn` Inference Speed (`55.8%` Inference vs. `44.2%` Tools): Total LLM inference across `259` turns took just `7m 51.8s` (`471.79s`, avg `1.82s/turn`, avg TTFT `1.14s`, longest single turn only `9.4s` on Turn 3 and Turn 28), while `276` tool calls took `6m 13.4s` (`373.41s`, including `344.91s` bash wall-time).

Exact Audit of `16` Reported `isError` Calls + `55` Pipeline-Masked Non-Zero Subcommands: Of `16` `isError: true` results, `10` were `bash` calls (`8` disposable signal/PTY/`stty` probes at Lines 47, 590, 650, 698, 710, 713, 725, 731 + `2` expected exit-1 CLI failure-mode checks at Lines 570, 805) and `6` were `omp` hashline `edit` guardrail rejections (`Lines 170, 178, 180, 195, 341, 776`, catching diff `-` prefixes, boundary overlaps, unseen ranges, and a syntax error before touching disk). Piping commands through `| tail` / `| head` masked `55` additional non-zero subcommands in `details.trace`: `33` failing red/debug `mix test` runs, `14` PTY/signal probes, `5` `git log | head -1` SIGPIPE (`141`) exits, and `3` expected non-zero `./cb` error-path checks.
